A look at the different types of free spins

Each free spins type comes with its own terms and specific conditions under which it can be used. That said, let’s take a closer look at the categories of casino free spins to give you a better idea of what to look out for.

1. No-deposit free spins

One of the best kinds of free spins that you can get, the free spins no-deposit bonus category allows you to really play for free.

With these types of spins, all you have to do is register at a casino — you don’t even need to deposit any money. You’ll get a number of online casino free spins just for being a new player once you’ve created an account.

In the US, no-deposit free spins are technically offered by PartyCasino, however, it’s standard practice at most casinos that you need to make a deposit in order to ‘activate’ your withdrawal options, so be aware of that.

  • Perfect for trying out a casino without risk
  • Winnings often require a deposit to withdraw

2. Daily free spins 

Daily free spins are a way of getting players to return to your site every day as they offer people an incentive to choose to play with you over others. Daily free spins are usually received as soon as you re-enter the casino but are saved for specific games.

In the interest of total honesty, we haven’t really seen these popping up at legal US casinos. The only casinos that seem to offer this deal are Stardust and Fanduel, which offer one daily free spin.

  • Keeps players engaged with consistent rewards
  • Limited availability and game selection

3. Mobile casino free spins

Some mobile casinos offer free spins, especially for players playing on handheld devices such as tablets and mobile phones. Casinos do this to encourage people to use their casino apps and to keep people playing on the go.

These mobile casino free spins can either come in the form of a bonus code sent to your app, or you might receive them upon downloading the app. Mobile-specific ones are quite rare, but most casinos with a free spins offer are available on mobile.

  • Convenient for playing on the go
  • Limited availability of true mobile-exclusive offers

4. New casino free spins

New casino free spins are a good way for you to try out the latest free spins casinos. New casinos also tend to offer good bonuses, as they’re trying to attract players and build up their reputation.

We’ll update this as soon as there’s a change, but currently; the newest casino offering a free spins bonus is PlayStar, which launched in 2022.

  • Generous bonuses designed to attract new players
  • Higher-than-average wagering requirements

5. Loyalty free spins

Some free spins casinos build loyalty by offering players free spins based on their spending habits or the length of time they’ve been active at the casino. These incentives reward consistent play and encourage long-term engagement.

PartyCasino stands out as a top pick for loyalty free spins in the US, offering perks through programs like the Golden Rewards program and M Life Rewards. These programs advertise exclusive promotional offers, giving dedicated players even more value.

BetMGM and Borgata also participate in the M Life Rewards program, so players can expect similar benefits at these casinos.

  • Rewards consistent play with meaningful perks
  • You sometimes have to deposit for a long time to get returns

6. In-game free spins

In-game free spins are the bonus rounds that you get on online slot games when you reach a certain level or get a certain combination of symbols on the slot machine. Hitting either of these targets will trigger a bonus round where you will get a windfall of free spins.

One common example is landing 3 or more scatter symbols in most slot games, such as in the Da Vinci Diamonds slot, where scatters can net you up to 300 free spins.

  • Enhances payouts without extra cost
  • Rare and luck-dependent trigger

Whenever I’m playing for in-game free spins, I always choose slots with medium volatility. A slot like Da Vinci Diamonds is perfect because its scatter symbols appear regularly enough to keep the gameplay exciting while maintaining a reasonable RTP.

For no-deposit free spins, I make it a point to check the maximum cashout limits in the terms. Many casinos cap winnings from these bonuses at $50–$100, so I focus on low-bet slots to stretch my spins.

US online casinos offer free spins as an extra incentive for people to sign up and play. Many players are usually drawn to free spins because of the free element, and the casinos get a new player. It’s a win-win situation.

How to use free spins

Free spins often activate automatically when you sign up or make a qualifying deposit. Some casinos require you to enter a bonus code during registration or deposit, so always double-check the promotion details.

While some casinos may let you choose from a selection of games, most free spins are tied to a single slot game. Additionally, the spins are typically limited to the minimum bet per spin, so you won’t get the full range of betting options.

Understanding playthrough requirements

Playthrough requirements are the key condition attached to free spins winnings. These requirements dictate how much you need to wager before you can withdraw your bonus. This is the casino’s way of forcing you to wager a certain amount, so it can potentially win the money you just earned back.

Playthrough requirements are always presented as a multiplier to your earned winnings. For example, if you win $50 from free spins and the playthrough requirement is 2x, you’ll need to wager $100 before cashing out.

Time2play Expert Analysis

Since playthrough requirements are based on wagering, not losing, focus on high RTP (Return to Player) games with low volatility. These give you the best chance to meet the requirements without depleting your balance.

Always check the terms for game contribution rates, as some slots may contribute more toward meeting these requirements than others.

Can you win real money with free spins? Things to consider

Yes, you can win real money with free spins, however, there are things that you need to take into consideration. With all online casino bonuses, you have to take into account things like wagering requirements, time limits, withdrawal limits, and any additional restrictions.

  • Wagering requirements

    Most free spins bonuses have wagering requirements, which refers to the amount of times you have to wager before getting your free spins for real money.

  • Time limits

    Most free slots come with a time limit in which you can use them. That means that you would need to wager in the time limit given to be able to get your winnings.

  • Withdrawal limit

    Many casinos place a withdrawal limit on what you are allowed to take out at a given time. This is done in order to encourage people to continue to play and not just take their money and never return.

  • Game restrictions

    Casinos that give out free slots usually limit players to playing a particular game in order for them to receive their free spins. That means that if you don’t play the games, you don’t get the spins.

FAQs

Can I win real money with free spins?

Are no-deposit free spins easy to find?

What are free spins no-deposit casinos?

Free spins no-deposit casinos offer players the opportunity to receive free spins without depositing any money. All you have to do is register with the casinos in question.

Are free spins for real money only available to new players?

No, not necessarily. In fact, you can get loyalty spins for playing a particular game for a long period of time or as part of a VIP program. Promotions vary from one site to another.
